classes.purpose: Interpret the concordato plan and explain numerical checks and discrepancies
classes.content: User instructions; plan documents and extracted text; financial schedules; recalculations; discrepancies; evidence locators; proposed findings and review decisions

security_controls.control: Run artifacts are written outside published repository paths.
Supported source bytes are captured before parsing and replayed against sealed receipts before review writes.
Filename suggestions remain non-operative until a reviewed, source-bound role, currency, unit, and complete numeric-disposition decision is supplied.
The deterministic payload and applied review state remain final_ready=false; semantic conclusion and publication require separate professional authority.

MCP review save and apply capture the bounded canonical output tree and modes in parent-process memory, run helpers only against a detached working tree, reject links, aliases, special or oversized entries, and restore exact trusted bytes and modes on any rejected commit.

The MCP parent binds caller run, review, current decisions, final state, source-role decisions, and output paths to the persisted trusted snapshot, replays every source, implementation, gate, ledger, review, final, and assurance-envelope receipt, and treats child output only as a bounded acknowledgement before commit.

Assured commands validate the exact 25-file implementation tree before workflow imports; authoritative numeric work requires paired reviewed source-role and calculation-formula decisions, the ledger closes every material CSV, XLSX and DOCX address, and save or apply seals an exact physical-output successor bound to the prior closure while professional readiness remains false.
